# High forest materials

`bark-color.jpg`, `bark-normal.jpg`, and `bark-roughness.jpg` are the 1K JPEG
Diffuse, OpenGL Normal, and Roughness maps from **Bark Brown 01**, by Rob Tuytel,
distributed by Poly Haven under **CC0 1.0**.

- Asset: https://polyhaven.com/a/bark_brown_01
- License: https://polyhaven.com/license
- CC0 deed: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
- Files obtained from the public asset manifest: https://api.polyhaven.com/files/bark_brown_01
- Accessed: 2026-09-25

The leaf shoot texture, mangrove branch/root meshes, and foliage placement are
original procedural artwork created for this project. The modeled forest is an
interpretation of mangrove structure, not a botanical survey or a photogrammetric
reconstruction of a particular tree.
